latest_release.name: v3.1.0
latest_release.body:
> [!NOTE]
> This release adds LDAP login with user sync, project copy and move between environments, and an adjustable background image blur. It also fixes agent request stalls, stricter API validation, and image update and prune handling.

### Features

- Add LDAP login and user sync (#4822) (@kmendell)
- Add project copy and move between environments (#4838) (@kmendell)
- Create missing external resources during project transfer (#4858) (@kmendell)
- Add adjustable background image blur (#4865) (@kmendell)
- Read image attestations from the local daemon first (28f9491) (@kmendell)
- Track agent readiness with renewable leases (#4804) (@kmendell)
- Aggregate environment data for remaining endpoints (#4829) (@kmendell)

### Performance

- Reuse cached data for instant detail navigation (#4818) (@kmendell)

### API

- Return 400 for malformed image references in the update check (#4815) (@jmrplens)
- Return 400 for unknown updater scope types (#4814) (@jmrplens)
- Return 400 for invalid swarm address pools and specs (#4816) (@jmrplens)
- Return 400 for API key grants on unknown environments (#4813) (@jmrplens)
- Compress JSON API responses with gzip (#4827) (@zichen0116)
- Document GitOps sync and Git repository request fields (#4805) (@jmrplens)
- Sort database lists by JSON field names (#4809) (@jmrplens)

### Agents and Environments

- Unblock agent requests stalled by database cursors and environment lookups (#4832) (@kmendell)
- Keep encoded path segments when proxying to agent environments (#4807) (@jmrplens)
- Open the SQLite read pool in agent mode (#4855) (@kmendell)
- List only environments with updates in the update-all plan (#4836) (@kmendell)

### Image Updates and Pruning

- Retry short registry rate limits and remove schedule jitter (#4802) (@kmendell)
- Tolerate already-removed images during prune (#4834) (@kmendell)
- Refresh the version stream on image update events (#4860) (@kmendell)
- Resume unsettled auto-update targets on retry (#4864) (@kmendell)
- Fall back to the KEV mirror when the CISA feed fails (#4835) (@kmendell)

### GitOps and Projects

- Preserve executable mode in GitOps backups (#4833) (@kmendell)
- Skip rewriting unchanged Compose files on environment-only project save (#4850) (@MaxWang007)

### Authentication

- Match federated issuers whose `iss` ends with a slash (#4811) (@jmrplens)

### User Interface

- Prevent update-all dialog title text overlap (#4853) (@kmendell)
- Wrap resource card footer metadata in grid view (#4854) (@kmendell)
- Show specific labels for activity center entries (#4859) (@kmendell)

### CI and Release

- Re-enable the GoReleaser announce step on release (#4798) (@kmendell)
- Sync Crowdin translations through main before release (#4839) (@kmendell)
